# Viet Air Filter (VAF)

> Viet Air Filter (VAF) is a Vietnamese manufacturer of industrial air filters, HEPA/ULPA filters, HVAC filtration products, and cleanroom equipment.

## Site

- Home: https://www.vietfil.com/
- About VAF: https://www.vietfil.com/about
- Products: https://www.vietfil.com/products
- Projects: https://www.vietfil.com/projects
- News: https://www.vietfil.com/news
- Contact: https://www.vietfil.com/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.vietfil.com/sitemap.xml

## Key Topics

- HEPA and ULPA filters
- Pre-filters and fine filters
- Cleanroom equipment
- HVAC air filtration
- ISO 16890 and EN 1822 filtration standards
- Cleanroom projects for electronics, pharmaceutical, healthcare, and commercial facilities
